notes: Box chosen on the old downtown north of Market (Kearny to Drumm), where solid black (commercial) and cross-hatched (light industrial) blocks are cut by many short alleys drawn as open paper; most alleys run in from a street and stop inside the block (dead ends), some run through. Every alley open to a street is street (the fill does it); a block with a dead-end alley is one area (U, E and H shapes, e.g. 2820,2440; 3050,2465; 3160,2415; 2815,2880; 3275,2593). FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) The alley at x 2457-2465 through the Sansome, Battery and Front blocks (y 2631-2712, 2735-2832, 2855-2957): the street name printed at the foot of each block crosses the alley. In the Sansome and Battery blocks the label frame is open where the alley meets the street, so the alley runs through; in the Front block the lettering hides it. Read as a through alley in all three (two blocks each: black west part, hatched east part); strokes along both sides of the alley through the lettering, so the lettering in the alley is street. (2) MONTGOMERY label (2412-2534, 2508-2532) runs out of its block across the street and touches the next block; strokes at x 2514 and x 2531 cut the lettering in the street off both blocks. (3) The strip with lettering at 3249-3304, 2560-2590 (a name, perhaps of the alley) is closed by its own line on the north and west; the slit under it (y 2591-2596) opens west and stops at x 3298: read as a dead-end alley and the strip as part of block 134 below. (4) St Mary's Square (2291-2389, 2244-2287) and Portsmouth Square (2658-2752, 2286-2358) are outlined like blocks and marked as blocks; St Mary's outline is broken, closed by a stroke along it. (5) Lower right: railway tracks run along the streets and through the gridded (heavy industrial) blocks and the Embarcadero. Strokes about 1.5 px inside the outlines of the gridded blocks (3123-3217 x 2992-3083, 3245- x 2992-3083, 2991-3086 x 3111-, 3123-3216 x 3115-) and the hatched blocks at 2992-3031, 3048-3088 (y 2988-3081) cut the tracks off the blocks so track ink in the street is street. The east edge of the block at 3123-3216 x 3115- is read as the track line from (3218,3143) to (3170,3174). (6) The small closed shape at about 3243-3268, 3108-3127 among the Embarcadero tracks (the corner of a gridded block cut by the tracks, or a track structure) is left unseeded (street); it may be a block. (7) Short strokes on block outlines where a track or dotted line touched a block (x 2970 and y 3080 near 2930-2980,3080-3176; x 3128 at 2675-2713; x 3246 at 2866-2962) or where an outline gap let the street into a hatched block's white holes (x 2584 at 2885-2925; x 2702 at 2795-2825). Hatch holes on a block's edge that the street reaches through small outline gaps remain as small street notches. Unseeded islands left as street: track remnants between gridded blocks (3232,3025; 3104,3133; 3008,3101; 3085,2968). Lettering and dotted lines in the streets need nothing.
